commands.title: Refresh File Tree
commands.description: Re-read the workspace file tree from disk.

commands.title: Toggle Ignored Files
commands.description: Show or hide git-ignored files in the file tree.

commands.title: Collapse Others
commands.description: Collapse every directory in the file tree except the workspace folders and the ancestors of the selected file.

commands.title: Reveal File in Tree
commands.description: Select a file in the file tree, expanding its parent directories; a no-op for a path outside the workspace folders.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to select.
